name: Tesla Spire · Cold
primary:
A copper tower of 11 blocks topped with a Tesla coil at the aim point. Material: magic copper, fades after 30 s. While the tower stands (up to 45 s), the coil zaps up to 3 nearest visible enemies within 12 blocks every 1 s:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
self_description:
A copper tower of 11 blocks topped with a Tesla coil at your feet. Material: magic copper, fades after 30 s. The tower lifts you up; every 1 s the coil zaps up to 3 enemies within 12 blocks:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
